# netactuate_cloud_vlan (Data Source)

Reads a Cloud Vlan.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_vlan" "example" {
  customer_vlan_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `customer_vlan_id` (Number) Customer VLAN ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `vlan` (List of Object) Customer VLAN details. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vlan))
